integration_kept_help_title: How to create an API token in Kept
integration_kept_help_step1: Open Kept and go to Settings, API tokens.
integration_kept_help_step2: Create a token with the permissions transactions:read, bills:read, links:write and categories:read.
integration_kept_help_step3: Copy the token right away: Kept shows it only once.
integration_kept_help_step4: Paste it here together with the address of Kept and connect. hauswart tests the connection right away and shows missing permissions.
integration_kept_help_hosts: People with administrator rights can connect any address. Other members can only connect hosts that an administrator put on the household's list.
integration_kept_error_unauthorized: Kept rejected the token. Create a new API token in Kept and replace the stored one.
integration_kept_error_forbidden: The Kept token lacks a permission or access to a category needed for this request. Test the connection to see which permissions are missing.
integration_kept_error_not_found: Kept does not know the requested address. Check that the address really belongs to Kept.
integration_kept_error_redirect: Kept answers with a redirect. Check that the address uses the right scheme (https) and host.
integration_kept_error_timeout: Kept does not answer in time. Check that it is running and reachable from hauswart.
integration_kept_error_network: hauswart cannot reach Kept. Check the address, port and network.
integration_kept_error_tls: The Kept certificate is not accepted. Use a valid certificate or turn off certificate checking for your home network.
integration_kept_error_server: Kept reports an internal error. Try again later.
integration_kept_error_invalid_response: Kept answered unexpectedly. Check that the address really points to Kept.
integration_kept_error_too_large: The answer from Kept is too large.
integration_kept_error_rate_limited: Kept is limiting requests. hauswart tries again later.
integration_kept_error_conflict: Kept refused the request because a limit was reached (at most 20 links per bill or transaction).
integration_kept_error_invalid_input: The request to Kept was not valid.
integration_generic_available: Setting up this connection will follow in a later step.
integration_generic_soon: Coming soon. This connection is not available yet.
integration_failures: {count, plural, one {1 failed attempt in a row} other {{count} failed attempts in a row}}
integration_ha_url_hint: The address of Home Assistant as hauswart reaches it, usually with port 8123.
integration_ha_url_invalid: Start the address with http:// or https://.
integration_ha_token_hint: A long-lived access token from your Home Assistant profile. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
integration_ha_token_hint_url: You changed the address. For safety, hauswart needs the token again.
integration_ha_token_required_url: Enter the token again because the address changed.
integration_ha_insecure_hint: For Home Assistant with a self-signed certificate.
integration_ha_insecure_warning: The connection stays encrypted, but hauswart does not check that it really reaches your Home Assistant. Only use this on your own home network.
integration_ha_app_url_hint: How phones reach hauswart. Links in push notifications are built from it. Empty: the address the server knows.
integration_ha_enabled_hint: While paused, hauswart reads no values and sends no push notifications. Tasks based on readings stay without a due date.
integration_ha_not_connected_member: Home Assistant is not connected yet. An administrator can set it up here.
integration_admin_only: Only administrators can change this connection.
integration_test_save_first: Save first to test the changed details.
integration_disconnect_description: The stored token and settings are deleted. Tasks, devices and hints that refer to Home Assistant stay, but no longer receive readings. Push notifications to phones stop.
integration_ha_help_title: How to create an access token in Home Assistant
integration_ha_help_step1: Open Home Assistant and click your name at the bottom left to open your profile.
integration_ha_help_step3: Scroll to the bottom to "Long-lived access tokens" and choose "Create token".
integration_ha_help_step4: Enter a name such as "hauswart" and confirm. Copy the token right away: Home Assistant shows it only once.
integration_ha_help_step5: Paste it here and save. hauswart tests the connection right away.
integration_ha_help_rights: The Home Assistant user needs administrator rights for areas (rooms) and devices. Without them readings and push work, but area names and device suggestions are missing.
integration_ha_help_push: You set up push notifications to your phone in your notification settings.
integration_error_invalid_url: The address is not valid. It must start with http:// or https://.
integration_error_unauthorized: Home Assistant rejected the token. Create a new long-lived access token and replace the stored one.
integration_error_forbidden: The Home Assistant user does not have enough permissions for this request.
integration_error_not_found: Home Assistant does not know the requested address. Check that the address really belongs to Home Assistant.
integration_error_redirect: Home Assistant answers with a redirect. Check that the address uses the right scheme (https) and host.
integration_error_timeout: Home Assistant does not answer in time. Check that it is running and reachable from hauswart.
integration_error_network: hauswart cannot reach Home Assistant. Check the address, port and network.
integration_error_tls: The Home Assistant certificate is not accepted. Use a valid certificate or turn off certificate checking for your home network.
integration_error_server: Home Assistant reports an internal error. Try again later.
integration_error_invalid_response: Home Assistant answered unexpectedly. Check that the address really points to Home Assistant.
integration_error_too_large: The answer from Home Assistant is too large.
integration_error_invalid_input: The request to Home Assistant was not valid.
integration_error_unknown: The connection failed. Try again later.
entity_reading_missing: Home Assistant does not know this entity. Check the id.
entity_reading_failed: The current value cannot be fetched right now.
entity_picker_error_manual: You can still type the id by hand.
entity_picker_broken: Home Assistant is not answering right now. The list may be incomplete.
entity_picker_manual: Not connected to Home Assistant: type the id by hand.
trigger_form_counter_entity_hint: A counter that counts up, such as wash cycles, operating hours or kilowatt hours.
trigger_form_calendar_entity_hint: The Home Assistant calendar whose events drive the task.
trigger_estimate_hint: When a reading falls or rises, such as the remaining life of a filter in percent, hauswart estimates when the target will be reached and shows that date ahead of time.
auto_complete_description: hauswart completes the task by itself as soon as Home Assistant reports something specific. The completion is recorded for the system, not for a person.
auto_complete_example: Example ventilation filter: done when the filter counter is reset.
auto_complete_counter_reset_hint: Done when the counter drops sharply, for example to zero after a filter swap.
auto_complete_state_change_hint: Done when the entity changes to a specific state.
auto_complete_min_drop_hint: If the counter falls by at least this much, the task counts as done.
auto_complete_from_hint: Only if the state was this before.
auto_complete_legacy: This task's counter: done when it drops by at least {minDrop}.
device_suggestions_description: Devices from Home Assistant that are not in the inventory yet. Adding creates a device with manufacturer, model and, if possible, room.
device_suggestions_empty_body: All Home Assistant devices are already in the inventory.
device_suggestions_ignored: {count, plural, one {1 ignored device} other {{count} ignored devices}}
device_suggestions_local_note: This browser remembers the ignored devices.
notify_description: Have notifications sent to your phone through Home Assistant and its companion app. In hauswart you always find every notification.
notify_push_enabled_hint: Off: you only see notifications in hauswart.
notify_targets_hint: Choose the phones or services that receive push notifications.
notify_not_connected_body: Push notifications go through Home Assistant. An administrator sets up the connection under Integrations.
notify_services_failed: You can still add services by hand.
notify_services_empty: Home Assistant offers no notify services. Install the companion app on your phone and sign in.
notify_manual_hint: The part after notify., lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
notify_manual_invalid: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.
notify_no_target: Push is on but no device is selected. Nothing will be sent.
notify_stages_title: Which notifications go to the phone?
notify_stages_hint: In hauswart you always see all of them.
push_stage_prep_hint: When a preparation step is coming up, such as ordering material.
push_stage_due_soon_hint: Shortly before a task is due.
push_stage_due_hint: On the day a task is due.
push_stage_overdue_hint: When a task becomes overdue, then weekly.
push_stage_hint_hint: When a care hint reacts to a change in Home Assistant.
push_stage_comment_hint: When someone comments on something that concerns you.
push_stage_digest_hint: Once a day, what is coming up.
notify_quiet_hint: Notifications in this period are held back and sent afterwards. Household time zone: {zone}.
notify_quiet_incomplete: Enter the start and end of the quiet hours.
notify_done_description: Task notifications on your phone have a "Done" button. Tapping it completes the task in hauswart in your name without opening the app.
notify_done_step1: Home Assistant has to report the tap to hauswart. That takes the "hauswart" package (see below).
notify_done_step2: Create an API token for Home Assistant (kind "Home Assistant", permission "Home Assistant actions").
notify_done_step3: Store it in Home Assistant's secrets.yaml as hauswart_bearer, worded "Bearer hw_…".
notify_done_package_hint: Save this as packages/hauswart.yaml (packages must be enabled in configuration.yaml) and reload the configuration.
feeds_description: Subscribe to your tasks in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar or any other calendar app. The address is secret: anyone who knows it can see titles, places and dates.
feeds_empty_body: Create a subscription to get upcoming tasks, preparations and deadlines into your calendar automatically.
feeds_limit_reached: You have reached the maximum number of subscriptions.
feeds_create_description: Choose what should appear in your calendar.
feeds_edit_description: The address stays the same. Calendar apps pick up the change on their next refresh.
feeds_scope_mine_hint: Tasks assigned to you and tasks without a fixed assignee.
feeds_scope_all_hint: All active tasks of the household.
feeds_include_preparations_hint: Steps such as “order a part” ahead of the due date.
feeds_include_warranties_hint: Warranties that end within a year.
feeds_include_estimated_hint: Marked as tentative (~), only within the next 45 days and without a reminder.
feeds_alarm_enable_hint: Your calendar alerts you before each event.
feeds_locale_hint: Titles such as “Prepare: …” appear in this language.
feeds_alarm_same_day: Reminder at {time} on the same day
feeds_url_missing: The address of this subscription can no longer be shown. Generate a new address.
feeds_rotate_description: The current address of “{name}” stops working immediately. Every device subscribed to it has to use the new address.
feeds_rotated_toast: “{name}” has a new address. The old one no longer works.
feeds_delete_description: “{name}” will be deleted. The address stops working immediately and calendar apps no longer show the events.
feeds_subscribe_description: Subscription “{name}”: scan the code with your phone or open the address in your calendar app.
feeds_qr_label: QR code of the subscription address of {name}
feeds_qr_webcal_hint: The camera app opens the Apple Calendar subscription prompt directly.
feeds_qr_https_hint: Plain address, e.g. to paste into Google Calendar.
feeds_howto_description: Copy the address or scan the QR code and add it in your calendar app.
feeds_howto_iphone_3: Paste the address, then tap “Next” and “Save”.
feeds_howto_google_1: Open Google Calendar on a computer (the app cannot add subscriptions).
feeds_howto_google_2: Next to “Other calendars” click “+” and choose “From URL”.
feeds_howto_google_3: Paste the address and click “Add calendar”. Google only refreshes subscriptions every few hours.
emergency_description: Everything you need in an emergency at {name}.
emergency_empty_title: Nothing set up for emergencies yet
emergency_empty_body: Mark contacts as emergency contacts, show devices on the emergency page or write pages in the “Emergency” or “Rules” section.
emergency_sheet_description: An A4 sheet with contacts, important places and the emergency and rules pages to print or hand over.
emergency_sheet_secrets_hint: Passwords, codes and other blocks marked as confidential.
emergency_sheet_secrets_warning: The sheet then contains real access details and is marked “Confidential”. Print it only, keep it safe and do not send it by e-mail or chat.
emergency_guest_description: Give guests or a stand-in a time-limited link with what they need, no account required and optionally with a PIN.
glinks_description: Share emergency info, house rules and instructions with guests or a stand-in without them needing an account.
glinks_empty_body: Create a time-limited link to hand over by message or QR code.
glinks_none_running: No link is active right now.
glinks_pin_locked: The link is locked after too many wrong PINs. Set a new PIN to reopen it.
glinks_create_description: Guests only see what is marked “visible to guests” and fits the chosen sections.
glinks_edit_description: The address stays the same. Changes apply immediately.
glinks_label_hint: For you only: who or what the link is for.
glinks_until_past: The date is in the past.
glinks_from_after: The start is after the end.
glinks_pin_hint: 4 to 8 digits. Hand over the PIN separately from the link.
glinks_pin_keep_hint: The existing PIN stays valid. It is no longer shown.
glinks_pin_none_hint: Anyone with the link can see the shared content.
glinks_sections_hint: A section only shows entries that are also marked “visible to guests”.
glinks_section_emergency_hint: Emergency pages and contacts marked as emergency contacts.
glinks_section_contacts_hint: All contacts visible to guests, without notes and address.
glinks_section_devices_hint: Devices shown on the emergency page and devices with a guest hint, with those hints only.
glinks_pages_hint: For pages outside the chosen sections, such as a general page. Only pages marked “visible to guests” can be chosen.
glinks_pages_empty: No page is visible to guests yet.
glinks_pages_hidden: Pages without “visible to guests” are not listed ({count}).
glinks_secrets_hint: Also shows blocks marked as confidential (codes, passwords).
glinks_secrets_warning: Guests will see real access details. Give the link and PIN only to people you trust.
glinks_secrets_warning_no_pin: Guests will see real access details and the link has no PIN: anyone who finds it sees everything. Set a PIN.
glinks_locale_hint: Guests see the interface in this language. The content stays as you wrote it.
glinks_reveal_description: Link “{label}” is ready to hand over.
glinks_reveal_warning: For security hauswart does not store the address. Copy it now. Later only a new address helps.
glinks_qr_label: QR code of the guest link {label}
glinks_share_failed: Sharing failed. Copy the address by hand.
glinks_preview_hint: The preview opens the link as guests see it and counts as a view.
glinks_reveal_pin_hint: The PIN is not stored and not shown again. Hand it over separately from the link.
glinks_rotate_description: The current address of “{label}” stops working immediately. You will see the new address once.
glinks_revoke_description: “{label}” stops working immediately. This cannot be undone, but you can create a new link at any time.
glinks_info_description: A guest link only shows content where two things line up.
glinks_info_both: The entry is marked “visible to guests” and the link shares the matching section (or the individual page).
glinks_info_secrets: Blocks marked as confidential stay hidden unless you explicitly include them in the link.
glinks_info_files: Files only appear if they are visible to guests themselves and belong to a shared page or hint.
glinks_info_dead: Expired, revoked and not yet valid links only show guests a neutral error page.
glinks_where_docs_body: In a page's editor: “Visible to guests”.
glinks_where_contacts_body: In a contact: “Visible to guests” and “Emergency contact”.
glinks_where_devices_body: On a device: “Show on emergency page”. On hints and files: “Visible to guests”.

feeds_howto_toggle: Instructions for iPhone and Google Calendar
household_host_allowlist_hint: Members may only connect their own accounts (Paperless, Kept) to these hosts. Administrators may use any host. While the list is empty, no member can save a connection.
household_host_allowlist_invalid: That is not a host. Enter a host name or address, optionally with a port (no http://, no path).
integration_error_blocked_host: This address is not allowed: link-local and cloud metadata addresses (and, for members, loopback) are never contacted.
